raidAlertDescKick: {n} accounts joined in {s} seconds, much faster than usual. It could be a raid. Until things calm down, ARCHON will remove new members whose account is younger than {days}.
raidAlertDescAlert: {n} accounts joined in {s} seconds, much faster than usual. It could be a raid. ARCHON isn't removing anyone automatically (the minimum account age is set to 0), so you may want to look at the member list.
raidAlertFooter: ARCHON checks again every 5 minutes and tells you when things are back to normal.
raidClearedTitle: Things are back to normal in {server}
raidClearedDesc: Joins have slowed down again. ARCHON keeps watching.
raidKickDesc:
{server} was getting a lot of new members at once, and at those moments it removes accounts younger than {days}. Yours is {age} old, so you were removed. This isn't about anything you did.
You're welcome to join again in {left}.
strikeDmFooter: ARCHON CG-223 • One appeal per server per day
strikeOwnerDesc:
**Server:** {server}
Only you, the server owner, see this report.
strikeOwnerFooter: ARCHON CG-223 • Only the server owner sees this
strikeWhyLeft: {who} had already left the server, so there was nothing to do.
strikeWhyPerm:
I couldn't {verb} **{who}**: the **{bot}** role is missing **{perms}**.
To fix it: Server Settings → Roles → **{bot}** → turn on **{perms}**.
strikeWhyAdmin: I couldn't time out **{who}**: Discord doesn't allow timing out members who have the Administrator permission.
strikeWhyOwner: I couldn't act on **{who}**: they own the server, and Discord doesn't let anyone act on the owner.
strikeWhyRole:
I couldn't {verb} **{who}**: their highest role, **{role}**, sits above mine.
To fix it: Server Settings → Roles → drag **{bot}** above **{role}**.
strikeWhyUnknown: I couldn't {verb} **{who}**, and I couldn't tell why. The **postcheck** command and Server Settings → Roles are the best places to look.
appeal_noStrikesDesc:
Nothing has been actioned on your account in any server I look after.

If you think a message was removed by mistake, tell me:

**Which server**
**What you posted**
**Why it should be allowed**

I'll pass it straight to the server owner.
appeal_listDesc: Here are the servers where an action is still on record:
appeal_listFieldValue:
Reply with:
"appeal [server name] | [your message]"

Example:
"appeal Testing bot | I was just excited, not flooding caps on purpose"

You get **one appeal per server every 24 hours** — make it count. Or reach out to the owner directly.
appeal_missingServerDesc:
Try:
"appeal [server name] | [your message]"

Example:
"appeal Testing bot | I was just excited, not flooding caps on purpose"
appeal_ambiguousDesc:
I couldn't tell where the server name ends and your message begins.

Use the pipe so I read it right:
"appeal [server name] | [your message]"

Example:
"appeal Testing bot | I was just excited, not flooding caps on purpose"
appeal_notFoundDesc:
I couldn't find a server matching **{name}**.

Send "appeal" on its own to see where you have active strikes.
appeal_bannedDesc:
You can't appeal on **{server}** for **{n} more {dayWord}** — a previous appeal was judged frivolous.

Use that time to write a better one.
appeal_cooldownDesc:
You've already sent an appeal for **{server}** today.

Try again in **{n} {hourWord}** — a calm, honest message works better than a quick one.
appeal_tribunalTitle: ⚖️ A new appeal just came in
appeal_tribunalFooter: ARCHON CG-223 · tap below to decide
appeal_submittedDescDm:
Your appeal for **{server}** just reached the owner.

Give them a bit of time — they'll read it and may reply directly.
appeal_submittedDescLog:
Your appeal for **{server}** couldn't reach the owner's DMs, so it was posted in the server's log channel.

The owner will see it there.
appeal_submittedDescQueued:
Your appeal for **{server}** is queued. The owner can review it with `/automod appeals`.

I couldn't reach them directly or through the log channel.
appeal_submittedFooter: One appeal per server per day — extra messages won't speed it up.
appeal_failedDesc: The appeal didn't go through. Try again in a moment — if it keeps failing, contact the server owner directly.
appeal_approvedDesc:
The owner of **{server}** accepted your appeal.

One strike has been lifted. Stay clean 🕊️
appeal_approvedTimeoutLifted: ⏰ Your timeout has been lifted — you can chat again.
appeal_approvedTimeoutExpired: ✅ (Your timeout had already expired on its own.)
appeal_rejectedDesc:
The owner of **{server}** read your appeal and decided to keep the current action in place.

You can try again in 24 hours. A calmer, more specific explanation usually helps.
appeal_banDesc:
Because of a previous appeal judged frivolous, you can't appeal on **{server}** for **7 days**.

A strike was also added to your account.
appeal_resultApproved:
✅ Approved by {user}
One strike lifted. User notified. {extra}
appeal_resultRejected:
Reviewed by {user}
Decision: action stays. User notified.
appeal_resultBanned:
Appeals paused by {user}
User cannot appeal for 7 days. +1 strike.

Non-mods: whitelisted domains only

Shield rules deployed to this server.

admin_domainsHint: Use `/automod domains add <domain>` to allow a new one, or `remove <domain>` to drop it.

admin_domainsInvalid: That doesn't look like a domain — try something like `example.com`

admin_raidPremiumRequired: ⭐ Raid detection is a Premium feature — use `/premium status` to upgrade.
appeal_notYoursDesc: Only the owner or a moderator can rule on this one.
decisionApproved: Approved — one strike lifted, timeout cleared.
decisionRejected: Reviewed — the action stays. User was notified.
